base.scope: Historical deterministic return-path analysis, not future probability or a new withdrawal backtest of the execution engine

capital_at_historical_median_monthly_ret.interpretation: Algebra only; undefined if median <=0. Median is not a dependable withdrawal rate and ignores losing months, tax and FX.

withdrawal_overlays.capital_requirement_interpretation: Frozen-path algebra, not recommended capital. Losing/flat windows cannot pay withdrawals while preserving principal at any positive capital.
Frozen-path algebra, not recommended capital. Losing/flat windows cannot pay withdrawals while preserving principal at any positive capital.

original_run_halt.interpretation: Original strategy halt only. Shifted windows reuse its realized path; they are not fresh-account reruns.

next_experiment_numeric_gates.selection_rule: These are next-test design gates, not a claim v1 meets them. Do not retune v1 or substitute a leveraged spot-return multiple.

limitations: KRW merely rescales USDT percentage returns; no FX path, taxes, operational expenses or remittance costs
Equity returns include unrealized PnL; realized_trade_pnl columns are separately reported
Withdrawal overlay preserves percentage returns and omits additional sales/costs/minimum-order effects; therefore is not execution-valid
Overlapping historical windows are dependent observations, never estimates of future success probability
Drawdowns exclude withdrawals; an overlay trigger is diagnostic and does not fabricate a new strategy liquidation
